# PixelPaint

> A browser art studio (painting, pixel art, animation, notes) at https://pixelpaint.net. Everything runs
> in the page; nothing is uploaded. AI agents can draw with it through a small JavaScript API.

## Scripting API

Open https://pixelpaint.net in a browser you control (Playwright, Puppeteer, a browser extension, the
devtools console) and call `window.PixelPaintAPI` (the same object as `window.pixelpaint.api`).

- Coordinates are picture pixels: (0, 0) is the top-left of the canvas, whatever the zoom.
- Colours are `'#rrggbb'`. Opacity and similar values take 0–1 (or 0–100).
- Every call goes through the normal tools and undo history: `api.undo()` reverses any step.
- Calls return `api.state()` (or a Promise of it, for `fill`). Bad arguments throw an Error that says what is allowed.
- Wait for the page to load first: `await page.waitForFunction(() => window.PixelPaintAPI)`.

### Look
- `state()` – size, layers (name, blend, opacity, visible, active), tool, colours, brush, selection, last undo step
- `snapshot({ scale, maxSize, type })` – the picture as a data URL (PNG by default); look at your work often
- `pixel(x, y)` – `{ color, alpha }` of the finished picture at a point
- `exportBlob(type)` – the picture as a Blob
- `tools()`, `brushes()`, `blendModes()`, `actions()` – what is available

### Make and change the canvas
- `newCanvas(width, height, { background: 'white' | 'transparent' | '#rrggbb', pixelArt, name })`
- `run(actionId)` – any menu command by id, e.g. `'image.flipH'`, `'filter.blur'`, `'file.exportPng'` (see `actions()`)
- `undo()`, `redo()`

### Draw
- `setColor('#rrggbb', 'fg' | 'bg')`, `setBrush('Ink Pen')` or `setBrush({ size, opacity, flow, smoothing })`, `setTool(id)`
- `stroke([[x, y], …], { brush, color, size, opacity, flow, tool })` – add a third value per point, 0–1, for pen pressure (thin to thick lines)
- `fill(x, y, { color, tolerance, contiguous })` – the fill bucket (await it)
- `click(x, y, opts)`, `drag(x0, y0, x1, y1, opts)` – any tool, e.g. shapes or the gradient
- `setOption(key, value)` – tool options as the options bar sets them

### Select (mode: 'replace' | 'add' | 'subtract')
- `selectRect(x, y, w, h, mode)`, `selectEllipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, mode)`, `selectPolygon([[x, y], …], mode)`
- `selectAll()`, `deselect()`, `fillSelection('#rrggbb')`, `clearSelection()`
- Brush strokes stay inside an active selection.

### Layers
- `addLayer(name, { blend, opacity, visible })` – the new layer becomes the one drawn on
- `setLayer(nameOrIndex, { name, blend, opacity, visible, locked })` – choose the layer to draw on, and change it. It always makes that layer the active one: after hiding a sketch layer, `setLayer` back to the layer you were on, or new layers land under it
- `deleteLayer(nameOrIndex)`
- Blend modes: Normal, Multiply, Darken, Color Burn, Screen, Lighten, Color Dodge, Add, Overlay, Soft Light, Hard Light, Difference, Exclusion, …

## Example

```js
const api = window.PixelPaintAPI;
api.newCanvas(800, 500, { background: '#1b2a5a', name: 'Night hills' });
api.addLayer('Moon');
api.selectEllipse(620, 120, 60, 60); api.fillSelection('#fff1c8'); api.deselect();
api.addLayer('Hills');
api.selectPolygon([[0, 380], [200, 280], [420, 350], [800, 300], [800, 500], [0, 500]]);
api.fillSelection('#173d2a'); api.deselect();
api.addLayer('Ink');
api.stroke([[80, 480], [84, 400, 0.5], [90, 330, 0.9], [96, 280, 0.2]], { brush: 'Ink Pen', size: 8, color: '#0b0b12' });
const png = api.snapshot({ maxSize: 512 });   // check the result
```

## Tips
- Build pictures in layers (sky, background, shapes, line art, glow with blend 'Add' or 'Screen'), as a person would.
- Big flat shapes: select a polygon, then `fillSelection`. Soft tone and atmosphere: 'Soft Round' at low opacity.
- Build-up brushes ('Airbrush') add paint over time, as a held spray can does; a scripted stroke is instant, so they leave very little. Use 'Soft Round' for predictable tone.
- For depth, push the values: a clear highlight, a dark core shadow just inside the shadowed edge, a lighter rim of reflected light, and the darkest contact shadow where an object meets the ground.
- Pixel art: `newCanvas(64, 64, { pixelArt: true, background: 'transparent' })`; strokes then use the Pixel Pencil, one pixel per point at size 1.
- A drawing is kept in the browser (File > My Art) as it changes; `run('file.exportPng')` downloads it.
